params.body:
The people the handover can name (#106) were reached through a "Mensen" button on Overdracht, which was easy to miss and sat oddly next to the CSV. They get a place in the menu.

## What changes

- **"Mensen" in the menu**, right after Overdracht: in the office menu, and in the menu of somebody on a shared link.
- **The page lost its own back link** ("Overdracht" above the title) now that the menu shows where it is.
- **Overdracht** keeps only its CSV button.
- **The hints point to the menu:** the one in a node's panel when the group is empty, and the one on Gebruikers.

## Tests

`CarrierPeopleTest`: a shared link sees the menu item. Full suite green.
